solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Playing online as no good, grasping spies hacked Gmail (6,6)

indicatorNotes.grasping: SONG holds the other letters in its grip
indicatorNotes.hacked: GMAIL is broken into, so its letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the five letters of GMAIL rearranged

annotation.surface: Someone playing online gets a hacked email account and blames snooping spies.
annotation.walkthrough: The two outer pieces meet to spell SONG, and the spies and the scrambled email service sit between them.
annotation.definitionFit: Social gaming is playing games online with other people.

entries.clue: Booze worked as vocalist spun melody (7)

indicatorNotes.spun: turned round, so AIR runs backwards

blocks.note: a vocalist sings, so working as one is 'sang'

annotation.surface: A singer had a drink and the tune went round in their head.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Air' as a tune is the crossword staple here.
annotation.definitionFit: Sangria is a Spanish wine punch, a kind of booze.

entries.clue: Left in African river, missionary expedition’s leaders share mass (14)

indicatorNotes.in: something left in a river is inside it, so L goes inside CONGO

blocks.note: the great river of central Africa

annotation.surface: A missionary expedition leaves its leaders in the Congo, sharing Mass.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Mass' looks religious beside the missionaries, but it is the definition in its plain sense of a heap.
annotation.definitionFit: A conglomeration is a mass of things gathered together.

entries.clue: Set about being contrary? (3,2)

indicatorNotes.being contrary: contrary means the other way round, so the letters are turned back

blocks.note: to set something down is to put it

annotation.surface: Someone decides to start being awkward.
annotation.walkthrough: The question mark flags double duty: 'being contrary' turns the letters round, and read whole the clue describes starting to misbehave.
annotation.definitionFit: To act up is to misbehave, to start being difficult.

entries.clue: Crude American releasing small amount of rude material (8)

indicatorNotes.releasing: lets go of a letter, removing it
indicatorNotes.small amount of: just a scrap of 'rude': its first letter

blocks.note: Amer. is the short form of American
first letter of rude, the letter released

annotation.surface: A crude American lets slip a bit of rude material.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Rude material' reads as smut, but 'material' alone is the definition and 'rude' only supplies the R to drop.
annotation.definitionFit: Gossamer is a very fine, filmy fabric.

entries.clue: Setting for Wuthering Heights or Othello? (4)

blocks.note: Emily Brontë's novel takes place on the wild open uplands of Yorkshire
Shakespeare's title character is a North African general in Venice

annotation.surface: A quiz question about where two classic tragedies are set.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Setting' makes both halves sound like locations, but Othello is a person: Shakespeare calls him the Moor of Venice.
annotation.definitionFit: One sense is open heathland, a definition by example from the novel's landscape; the other is the old word for a North African, Othello's epithet.

entries.clue: Network, groove, and fool around like night owls (9)

indicatorNotes.around: turns the whole string round, so it reads upwards

annotation.surface: Late-night partygoers network, dance to the groove and mess about.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Fool around' looks like one phrase meaning to mess about, but 'around' works on all three pieces at once, not just the fool.
annotation.definitionFit: Night owls are active at night, which is what nocturnal means.

entries.clue: Fantastic composer, calm at grand, with Salieri getting upset (7,7)

indicatorNotes.getting upset: the letters are knocked over and rearranged

annotation.surface: A composer calmly at the piano while his rival Salieri frets.
annotation.walkthrough: The musical scene points to a composer of music, but this one composes fiction: a writer of fantastic tales.
annotation.definitionFit: A magical realist writes fiction that mixes the fantastic with the everyday.

entries.clue: Potential danger hospital is boring nurse (6)

indicatorNotes.boring: H bores into TREAT, sitting inside it

blocks.note: to nurse a patient is to treat them
h = hospital, as on road signs

annotation.surface: A patient complains that the hospital nurse is a real bore.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Boring' looks like a complaint about the nurse; it is the instruction to drill H into TREAT.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a threat is danger that has not yet arrived, which 'potential' captures.

entries.clue: Several performing? In hindsight, slightly fewer (5)

indicatorNotes.In hindsight: looking back, so TEN is read backwards

blocks.note: slightly fewer than ten means not ten: 'no'
the ten that is fallen short of, read backwards

annotation.surface: A reviewer thinks back and reckons there were rather fewer performers than billed.
annotation.walkthrough: A nonet has nine players, just short of ten: 'no ten', with the TEN looked at in hindsight.
annotation.definitionFit: A nonet is a group of nine musicians performing together.

entries.clue: School keeps toilet within another, a sluggish one (9)

indicatorNotes.keeps: SCH holds the rest inside it
indicatorNotes.within: within means inside, so the toilet named first sits inside the other

blocks.note: sch. is the short form of school
wc = water closet, placed inside LOO
as written, joining the toilets inside SCH

annotation.surface: A school lavatory block is so slow it needs a second toilet inside.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Another' carries no letters of its own meaning; it stands for a second word for toilet, which is why one toilet ends up inside the other.
annotation.definitionFit: A slowcoach is a person who moves or works slowly.

entries.clue: Really poor casting or poor performance of part? (4,4)

indicatorNotes.poor: the letters are in a poor state, so rearranged

blocks.note: cast out of REALLYPOOR, leaving REALLYPO to rearrange

annotation.surface: A critic pans a production: terrible casting and a poor performance in the role.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Casting' looks like theatre talk, but it throws OR away; the second 'poor' is the anagram signal.
annotation.definitionFit: A near-literal gloss: role play is acting a part, and 'part' is theatre's word for a role.

entries.clue: Laid out voguish drug after drink (6)

indicatorNotes.after: after means following in time, so the fashionable drug is placed behind the drink

annotation.surface: Someone flat out after a drink and a trendy drug.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is a partygoer passed out, which is exactly what the answer means.
annotation.definitionFit: Supine means lying on one's back, laid out.

entries.clue: Accepted both sides in Anfield wearing baseball gear? (8)

indicatorNotes.both sides in: take the two outside letters of Anfield

blocks.note: the first and last letters of Anfield
a baseball fielder wears a mitt, so is 'mitted'

annotation.surface: Liverpool and Everton players turn up at Anfield in baseball gloves.
annotation.walkthrough: Anfield is Liverpool FC's ground, so 'both sides' suggests two football teams; it means the two ends of the word.
annotation.definitionFit: Admitted means accepted, let in or conceded.

entries.clue: Picture best supporting actor, half-cut (3,6)

indicatorNotes.supporting: in a down clue, CREAM sits under THES and holds it up
indicatorNotes.half-cut: British slang for tipsy, read literally: the word is cut down to half its length

blocks.note: an actor is a THESPIAN; half of its eight letters
the cream is the best of anything

annotation.surface: The best supporting actor award goes to someone who turned up drunk.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Best supporting actor' reads as the award; 'half-cut' (British slang for drunk) is really cutting THESPIAN in half.
annotation.definitionFit: The Scream is Edvard Munch's famous painting.

entries.clue: Youthful new lover consumed by sex (6)

annotation.definitionNote: infant used as an adjective, as in 'infant industries'

indicatorNotes.consumed by: N FAN is swallowed inside IT

blocks.note: a fan is a lover of something

annotation.surface: A young new lover is all-consumed by sex.
annotation.walkthrough: IT for sex is a crossword convention: N and FAN go inside it.
annotation.definitionFit: Infant can describe something young or at an early stage.

entries.clue: Duke feeding Henry egg prepared with needles (4-4)

indicatorNotes.feeding: to feed something is to put it in, so the duke goes inside Henry's name

blocks.note: Hank is a familiar form of Henry
a nit is the egg of a louse

annotation.surface: A duke feeds Henry an egg that has been prepared with needles.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Egg' and 'prepared' suggest cooking, but the egg is a louse's and the needles are for knitting.
annotation.definitionFit: A descriptive paraphrase: knitting by hand is done with a pair of needles, so the needles stand for the craft.

entries.clue: Boundary one put up with no area inside (6)

indicatorNotes.with no: 'with no area' means lacking A, so that letter is dropped from inside

blocks.note: a boarder is someone put up in your home
a = area, removed from inside BOARDER

annotation.surface: A boundary where one person tolerates another who has no room.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Put up with' reads as tolerated, but 'one put up' is the lodger and 'with no' is the deletion.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym, as in the border between two countries.

entries.clue: Animal sounds reported to cook (6)

indicatorNotes.reported: said out loud, so a word that sounds like it

annotation.surface: Noises from the farmyard are said to be about cooking.
annotation.walkthrough: A donkey's call is a bray; said aloud, 'brays' matches the cooking word.
annotation.definitionFit: To braise is to cook slowly in a little liquid in a closed pot.

entries.clue: Completely misguided artist wearing backless fleece jumper (8)

indicatorNotes.misguided: RA is sent the wrong way, becoming AR
indicatorNotes.wearing: WOO wears ALL AR like a coat
indicatorNotes.backless: the last letter of WOOL is taken off

blocks.note: RA (Royal Academician) sent astray: its two letters rearranged

annotation.surface: A misguided artist puts on a fleece jumper with the back missing.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Fleece jumper' reads as knitwear, but the jumper is an animal: a wallaroo is a kind of kangaroo.
annotation.definitionFit: A wallaroo is a large kangaroo, a famous jumper.

entries.clue: Late public music performance completely out of time (7)

indicatorNotes.completely out of: 'out of' means without, and 'completely' says to remove it every place it occurs

blocks.note: t = time, removed wherever it appears

annotation.surface: A late performance of public music in which the players are hopelessly out of time.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Out of time' sounds like bad rhythm, but it means remove T; 'completely' says remove both.
annotation.definitionFit: Overdue means late, past the expected time.

entries.clue: Offensive “cheers” when returning food (6)

indicatorNotes.returning: coming back, so TA is read backwards

blocks.note: tack is food, as in hard tack

annotation.surface: A rude toast offered as a dish is sent back.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Offensive' looks like an adjective, but it is the noun: a military offensive.
annotation.definitionFit: The noun sense of 'offensive', a military campaign, is a synonym, not the adjective the surface suggests.

entries.clue: A reservoir selling water (5,3)

blocks.note: a dam holds back a reservoir, and the word can mean the water itself

annotation.surface: A reservoir is selling off its water.
annotation.walkthrough: Adam's ale is an old joking name for water, the only drink Adam had.
annotation.definitionFit: Adam's ale is a humorous term for plain water.

entries.clue: Wrong item to go round rabbi’s head? (5)

annotation.definition: Wrong item to go round rabbi’s head?

indicatorNotes.Wrong: letters in the wrong order need rearranging
indicatorNotes.to go round: to go round something is to encircle it, so the rearranged item surrounds the R
indicatorNotes.head: the head of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: ITEM rearranged, then split round the R

annotation.surface: Someone puts the wrong hat on a rabbi.
annotation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue is the definition: a mitre is a bishop's hat, so it is the wrong thing for a rabbi's head.
annotation.definitionFit: A mitre is headgear, though a bishop's rather than a rabbi's.

entries.clue: Fibrous part taken from scampi, thankfully (4)

indicatorNotes.taken from: the letters are lifted out of the words that follow

blocks.note: the last two letters of scampi run into the first two of thankfully

annotation.surface: A diner is relieved that the stringy bit was removed from the scampi.
annotation.walkthrough: The answer spans two words, running from the end of 'scampi' into 'thankfully'.
annotation.definitionFit: Pith is the fibrous tissue of a fruit or stem.

entries.clue: European place, not quite wild Vienna (9)

indicatorNotes.not quite: falls just short, losing its last letter

blocks.note: place = SLOT, minus its last letter

annotation.surface: A European city described as not quite as wild as Vienna.
annotation.walkthrough: 'European place' looks like the definition, pointing to a country; the definition is only 'European', a person.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by category: a native of Slovenia is one kind of European.

entries.clue: Improviser initially overwhelmed by jazz chord (5)

indicatorNotes.initially: initially means at the start, so only the word's opening letter is used
indicatorNotes.overwhelmed by: something overwhelmed is engulfed, so the letter is swallowed inside the jazz word

annotation.surface: A jazz soloist is drowned out by the band's chords.
annotation.walkthrough: TRAD, short for traditional jazz, is a British term.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by category: the triad, three notes stacked in thirds, is the basic chord of Western harmony.

entries.clue: Pressure troops trailing unit to strike arena (12)

indicatorNotes.trailing: HEAT RE follows behind AMP HIT

blocks.note: the amp is a unit of current

annotation.surface: Military pressure as troops follow a unit to attack a stadium.
annotation.walkthrough: The clue reads in the wrong order: the first two items trail behind the last two, so start from 'unit'.
annotation.definitionFit: An amphitheatre is an open arena with tiered seating.
